article_title: India's 'cockroach' protesters set to return despite police crackdown

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A youth-led movement plans another Delhi protest over electoral reforms and protest rights despite arrests and a major police crackdown.
India has approved Central Park as its only national election venue.
The CJP has ended its campaign after the education minister resigned.
Delhi police have invited opposition parties to organise a joint march.
tasks.correct_answer: A youth-led movement plans another Delhi protest over electoral reforms and protest rights despite arrests and a major police crackdown.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את כוונת תנועת CJP להפגין שוב בדלהי בדרישה לרפורמות בחירות וזכות המחאה, למרות מעצרים ודיכוי משטרתי.

tasks.prompt: Where did the CJP call on supporters to gather for Friday's protest?
options: Ramlila Maidan
Central Park in Connaught Place
The Election Commission headquarters
The grounds of the Supreme Court
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התנועה קראה לתומכיה להתכנס בסנטרל פארק שבקונוט פלייס, אזור מסחרי עמוס שאינו אתר מחאה מאושר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “leadership depleted” mean?
options: The movement has gained several new national leaders.
The organisers have abandoned electoral reform.
The movement has fewer key leaders available because some are jailed.
Police have officially recognised the CJP as a political party.
tasks.correct_answer: The movement has fewer key leaders available because some are jailed.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: depleted פירושו מצומצם או מוחלש; שני מארגנים מרכזיים נכלאו ולכן הנהגת התנועה זמינה פחות לקראת המחאה.

tasks.prompt: What change to electoral rolls is at the centre of the CJP's current campaign?
options: A Special Intensive Revision that critics say removed more than 130 million names
A plan to lower the voting age to sixteen
A requirement that all voting take place online
A court order adding 130 million foreign voters
tasks.correct_answer: A Special Intensive Revision that critics say removed more than 130 million names
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מוקד המחלוקת הוא SIR, עדכון מקיף של פנקסי הבוחרים, שלטענת המבקרים הסיר יותר מ־130 מיליון שמות.

tasks.prompt: Why does the dispute over Jantar Mantar matter beyond the location itself?
options: It is the only place in Delhi with public transport.
It is close to parliament and symbolically keeps dissent visible near political power.
It is owned by the CJP's founder.
It guarantees that every demonstration is legally approved.
tasks.correct_answer: It is close to parliament and symbolically keeps dissent visible near political power.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג׳נטר מנטר הוא אתר מחאה היסטורי סמוך לפרלמנט; הרחקת מפגינים ממנו עשויה להפחית את הנראות והלחץ על מוקדי הכוח.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean when it says the demands of separate protest groups have “converged”?
options: They have become increasingly similar or aligned.
They have been withdrawn after negotiations.
They concern unrelated local elections.
They have moved to different cities.
tasks.correct_answer: They have become increasingly similar or aligned.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: converged פירושו התקרבו או התאחדו: אף שהקבוצות פעלו בנפרד, דרישותיהן נעשו דומות יותר.

tasks.prompt: What measures did police use to prevent the CJP's previous mass demonstration?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין פריסת כוחות רחבה, חסימת כבישים, סגירת תחנות מטרו, מחסומים, יירוט ומעצרים לפני ההתכנסות ופיזור מי שהתאספו במקום אחר.
expected_points: Tens of thousands of police and paramilitary personnel were deployed across Delhi.
Roads were sealed and metro stations were shut.
Barricades, interception and mass detentions stopped many protesters before they reached Jantar Mantar.
People who gathered elsewhere were quickly dispersed.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the CJP developed from its origins to its present electoral campaign.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את הכינוי שהפך לזהות, מחאות דליפת הבחינות וההתפטרות, המעבר למאבק בפנקסי הבוחרים, והמאבק הרחב יותר על זכות המחאה.
expected_points: The movement began after the chief justice compared some unemployed young people to cockroaches, and Dipke adopted the label.
It grew online and then mobilised street protests over examination paper leaks.
Those protests contributed to Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.
The CJP now challenges the electoral-roll revision and the Election Commission, while also defending the right to protest.

tasks.prompt: How could the authorities' security response strengthen rather than weaken the CJP's political message?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמעצרי מנהיגים ועיתונאים, סגירת אתרים ודיווחי אלימות יכולים להרחיב את הסיפור מזיוף בחירות לחירויות אזרחיות, לעורר הזדהות ולקרב קבוצות אופוזיציה.
expected_points: Mass detentions and venue restrictions support the CJP's claim that protest rights are being curtailed.
Reports and footage of force against detainees can attract public attention and sympathy.
Jailing organisers can turn them into symbols of resistance rather than ending the campaign.
The crackdown may align the CJP more closely with students and opposition parties that share electoral concerns.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced briefing on the competing arguments over Friday's planned protest.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טענות CJP על רפורמת הבחירות וחופש המחאה, את חששות המשטרה והסוחרים מסדר ציבורי ותנועה, את עמדות ועדת הבחירות והממשלה, ולציין שההאשמות שנויות במחלוקת.
expected_points: Explain that the CJP alleges voter-roll irregularities, seeks the election commissioner's resignation and defends visible protest near political power.
Note that police cite public order and unauthorised gatherings, while a trader raised traffic and business disruption.
State that the Election Commission and government deny favouring the BJP, and the home minister defends the commission's independence.
Clarify that Central Park is not an approved protest venue and that the High Court declined to restrain the CJP.
